crownPassive.name: Hunter's mark
crownPassive.text: Each round, while planning, choose one enemy hero. All your attacks on it deal +2 damage, and if it is a Beast it can't heal that round.

bond.text: +1 Attack for each other Märchen hero you field, up to +2.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Stones in the belly
actions.text: A Ranged attack that also drops the target's Speed to 1 for the rest of the fight.
